title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy Baltimore show with a monster second set and standout performances by Jerry, Phil and Brent.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this April 19 1982 Baltimore concert, calling the band “on fire” from start to finish. The second set – especially Feel Like A Stranger → Franklin’s Tower → Estimated Prophet → Terrapin Station and the Raven/Space segment – is highlighted as one of the best ever, while the matrix mix (60 % soundboard, 40 % audience) is praised as crystal‑clear and perfectly balanced.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance (high energy, many standout songs) and the technical quality of the matrix mix, indicating an exceptional show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 60 % soundboard + 40 % audience blend; reviewers describe it as the best‑sounding source for this concert, crisp and well‑balanced with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows flawlessly with tight transitions, especially the Feel Like A Stranger → Franklin’s Tower → Estimated Prophet → Terrapin Station sequence; encore rounds out a strong finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals sound as good as ever and guitar work on 'They Love Each Other' and 'Peggy-O' is described as simply amazing.
band_member_comments.Phil: "More nitrous!" – bass is high‑energy and powerful throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland (keys) is "in high‑gear", delivering strong keyboard work during the set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann (referred to as Bobby) is praised for being in high‑gear, driving the performance.
